exceptions.reason: max-stale handling can disclose a cached response to another user of a shared cache. Astro 7.3.5 uses the package only in dist/assets/build/remote.js, to decide whether a remote image fetched during the static build may be reused from the build cache. A build serves no users, so no response can cross users. No fixed release exists: http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 is the latest, and astro 7.3.5 requires ^4.2.0.
